children: Old Dominion Freight Line reported August LTL revenue per day rose 12.4% while LTL tons per day fell 0.9% versus August 2025.
Revenue per day increased 12.4% vs. Aug 2025 due to higher LTL revenue per hundredweight.
LTL tons per day decreased 0.9%, driven by a 2.4% drop in shipments per day.
LTL weight per shipment rose 1.7%, partially offsetting lower shipments per day.
Quarter-to-date LTL revenue per hundredweight up 11.3%; excluding fuel surcharges up 4.8% YoY.
